preregistered.comparator_note: 4-mer counts + ridge, recomputed IN-RUN on identical splits/seeds. The census's 0.1313 is context, NOT the comparator: a cited number from a different split cannot be paired.
preregistered.primary_metric: spearman on the held-out genomic blocks
preregistered.margin_note: INHERITED from the tile-rung arms so the bars stay commensurable, and the inheritance is disclosed because it is NOT scale-free: 0.02 against this rung's incumbent (~0.13) is a ~15% relative gain, whereas against the tile rung's ~0.40 it is ~5%. The verdict keys on the ABSOLUTE 0.02; the relative figure is reported beside it so no reader is misled.
preregistered.span_decades_note: MEASURED over all 321,123 LB fragments: median 244 bp (1.9103 decades), p99 308 bp (2.011), max 499 bp (2.2210). Only 4.0% of rows reach 300 bp and 0.015% reach 400 bp. Against the measured tile sibling's 1.70 decades the honest gain is +0.21 at the MEDIAN (244/150 = 1.63x more length), NOT the +0.52 / 3.33x the maximum suggests. Quote the median figure; the max describes 49 fragments.
preregistered.length_rule: zero-pad to 499 with MASKED pooling; padded positions excluded

verdicts.PYRAMID_ADDS: gain >= margin AND >= min_seeds_winning seeds win -- a reproducible lift
verdicts.WEAK_PYRAMID: gain > 0 AND >= min_seeds_winning seeds win, but below the margin -- a REPRODUCIBLE gain that fell short of the effect-size bar
verdicts.INDETERMINATE_GAIN_NOT_REPRODUCIBLE: gain > 0 but FEWER than min_seeds_winning seeds win -- a positive gain that did NOT reproduce, which is neither a measured lift nor a measured negative and must not be read as either
verdicts.NO_GAIN: gain <= 0 -- the pyramid does not beat the length-invariant default
verdicts.INVALID_NULL_SCORED: the shuffled-label control scored; nothing may be graded
verdicts.INVALID_PAD_LEAKED: padding changed a score; the masked-pooling premise is broken

validity_controls.shuffled_labels: train labels permuted; must score ~0 or the run is INVALID
validity_controls.pad_invariance: a sequence must score identically whatever length it is padded to
validity_controls.length_matched_subset: AMENDED 2026-10-27 from >= 400 bp to >= 300 bp, BEFORE any encoder number existed. The 400 bp threshold was frozen without measuring the distribution and selects 49 of 321,123 rows (0.015%) -- a control too small to falsify anything, which is worse than no control because it LOOKS like one. 300 bp selects 12,896 rows (4.0%) and is powered. Still the minority of the substrate, so it is a padding check, NOT a second headline. If the headline and this subset disagree in SIGN, padding is implicated and the headline is WITHDRAWN rather than explained.

preregistered.prediction_rationale: Recorded BEFORE the run. Four reasons a negative is expected: (a) the conv encoder already failed to beat a SINGLE GC NUMBER on the easier tile rung (+0.0122, paired CI includes zero); (b) `load_fragments`' own docstring argues k-mer features are the honest default here precisely BECAUSE they are length-invariant, which is the property a fixed-window conv lacks; (c) this rung's best measured arm reaches only 0.1313 of a 0.7928 ceiling (16.6%), so the recoverable signal looks thin for every model class, not just this one; (d) more SPAN is only useful if regulatory signal actually lives above 150 bp, which is the hypothesis under test and not an assumption in its favour.
preregistered.negative_scope: A negative here means: a 4-scale conv pyramid over zero-padded, masked-pooled fragments, trained under the registered protocol on block-split LB fragments, did not beat 4-mer counts + ridge by 0.02 Spearman. It would NOT mean sequence context above 150 bp is uninformative, NOT that multi-resolution modelling fails in general, and NOT anything about the tile rung, which has a different ceiling and a different incumbent.
preregistered.revival_condition: a length-invariant architecture (dilated conv, attention with length masking) or a rung whose fragments are long enough that padding is negligible across the whole set.

status_note: The k-mer comparator and every pre-registered design decision are in place and the block split is exercised. The pyramid half needs the masked-pooling encoder, which is NOT the shipped `fit_encoder` (that one requires uniform length and pools unmasked). No verdict is emitted: a verdict from a one-sided run would be a figure, not a measurement.
